coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output partially matches the tetrapeptide system and torsion/TICA feature analysis, including mention of PyEMMA. Most required experimental variables and measurements are not specified, yielding 25% overall alignment.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits explicit-solvent all-atom MD settings, first-frame-conditioned MDGEN generation of 10 ns segments concatenated into 100 ns trajectories, and the explicit MDGEN-versus-reference-MD comparison. It does not specify sine/cosine feature encoding or JSD measurements for backbone, sidechain, and TICA-0 distributions. Its alternative binning rules do not match the required 100-bin backbone analysis. Numerous additional controls and analysis rules do not substitute for these missing variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: No conclusion was provided, so it cannot semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output omits the expected low torsion-distribution JSD values, reasonable TICA-0 alignment, and recovery of slow and fast dynamics and metastable regions.
